From the initial concept to the final installation at the customer's site, you will play an active role throughout the entire project lifecycle. This is a varied position combining engineering, assembly, testing and international commissioning.

• Building, assembling and testing prototypes.
• Installing, commissioning and fine-tuning equipment at customer sites both nationally and internationally.
• Analysing technical issues and proposing improvements to products and processes.
• Preparing technical documentation, manuals and work instructions.
• Collaborating closely with colleagues from engineering, production and service departments.
• Providing technical support during demonstrations, trade fairs and commercial activities.

For this positFor this position as Project Engineer Machine Building, we are looking for an all-round engineer who enjoys combining theory with hands-on technical work. You like taking ownership of projects from start to finish and are willing to travel internationally on a regular basis.

• A strong interest in machine building, automation and product development.
• A hands-on mentality and practical approach to engineering.
• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
• Willingness to travel internationally for installations and commissioning projects.
• A good command of English.
• Knowledge of Dutch is mandatory.
• A valid Category B driving licence.

For a fast-growing manufacturing company, we are looking for a hands-on ERP Application Manager.
The group will implement a new ERP package (MS Dynamics F&O) and want to attract someone who will lead this project.
 

In this key role, the application manager will act as the bridge between the needs of their business departments and the ERP solution, ensuring seamless implementation across the organization.
 

This is a job on-site in Tournai with travel to their production site in France from time to time.
 

Functie
 
 

• Understand and analyze the current systems (own build applications) to identify opportunities for improvement. 

• Collaborate with departments (production, logistics, finance, etc.) to gather their needs and ensure they are reflected in the ERP system. 

• Lead the ERP implementation, introducing modules step by step while ensuring strong alignment across internal teams. 

• Direct the software partner and other external consultants. 

• Evaluate and optimize current processes to improve efficiency, standardization, and flexibility. 

• Identify custom needs and differentiate ERP functions from other tools (e.g., WMS, MES, BI). 

• You give support and training to the users. 

• Define user roles and access levels, as well as onboarding procedures for new employees. 
 

• At least 3 years of experience implementing ERP systems (SAP, D365, or equivalent). 

• A solid understanding of software environments (ERP, WMS, CMMS, MES, CRM, HR systems). 

• Experience in the food industry or knowledge of traceability systems (a plus). 

• Project management expertise: Familiarity with principles and methodologies to manage ERP rollout projects. 

• Strong problem-solving skills to handle technical challenges quickly and effectively. 

• Excellent communication skills to interact with stakeholders at all levels. 

• A detail-oriented mindset to ensure system accuracy and data integrity.  
 

• You’re independent, a great team player, and excel in building connections. 

• Dynamic, proactive and curious. 

• Fluency in English. Knowledge of French and Dutch is a plus.

This is a full-time role for an Inside Sales (ENG) who speaks English, based in Merchtem. 
 

You will be responsible for communicating with customers, handling orders, and coordinating with the warehouse team to ensure smooth and timely delivery of products.
 

Additionally, the Internal Sales Employee will prepare sales quotations, follow up on leads, and collaborate closely with the sales teams. The focus  for this position is the region of Eastern Europe and English-speaking markets.
 

Is this job, where you can use your communication skills and languages, for you? Apply now via this site!

 

• Ability to work independently as well as within a team. 

• You are fluent in English. 

• Proficiency in additional languages is considered an advantage. 

• Excellent communication and customer service skills.

What you'll do :
 
 

• Understand clients' business needs and translate them into clear, feasible end-to-end AI solutions 

• Act as a trusted point of contact for clients throughout the project, from scoping to delivery 

• Run discovery sessions and technical workshops with business and technical stakeholders 

• Design and build AI solutions combining LLMs, vector databases, APIs, orchestration layers and user interfaces 

• Develop agents and RAG pipelines connecting client data to LLMs for grounded, reliable answers 

• Perform prompt and context engineering to improve output quality and reduce hallucinations 

• Build, train and evaluate classical ML models (classification, regression, forecasting, clustering) when they are the best fit for the problem 

• Handle the data side: gathering, cleaning, validating data quality and feature engineering 

• Evaluate solutions rigorously, using ML metrics, generative AI metrics and production monitoring (quality, drift, costs) 

• Deploy solutions to the cloud with attention to security, reliability and cost efficiency, including versioning and reproducibility of models and data 

• Present and explain AI concepts, trade-offs and results to non-technical audiences 

• Support sales in qualifying opportunities, estimating effort and writing proposals 

• Contribute to demos, proofs of concept and internal knowledge sharing 

Who we're looking for :
 
 

• You hold a Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, Mathematics, Statistics or a related field 

• You have 2 to 5 years of experience in AI/ML engineering or related fields 

• You're proficient in Python and software development best practices 

• You have strong machine learning fundamentals: supervised and unsupervised learning, feature engineering, model validation and the statistics behind them 

• You have hands-on experience with the Python data and ML stack: Pandas, NumPy, Scikit-learn and PyTorch (or TensorFlow) 

• You have a solid understanding of LLM fundamentals: Transformers, generation parameters, RAG and fine-tuning approaches 

• You have hands-on experience with tools such as the OpenAI API, Hugging Face, LangChain/LangGraph, FastAPI and Docker 

• You're comfortable working with data in SQL databases 

• You're a natural consultant: you listen, ask the right questions and see the business behind the technical problem 

• You're comfortable presenting to clients and explaining complex topics simply 

• You have strong problem-solving ability and a pragmatic, solution-oriented mindset 

• You have a team spirit and enjoy collaborating across multiple roles 

• You're autonomous, curious, and quick to learn new tools 

• You can communicate fluently in English and French or Dutch

jobs.description:
As a Project Lead Multidisciplinary Engineering – Data Centres, you coordinate the entire engineering and design process. You monitor the technical scope, planning and engineering budget, ensuring that the different disciplines work together towards one integrated design.

• Coordinate multidisciplinary engineering teams within complex data centre projects

• Manage the technical scope, engineering budget and associated contract documentation

• Prepare and monitor the engineering schedule and allocate tasks within the team

• Coordinate the different technical disciplines and ensure alignment between their designs

• Coordinate collaboration between Belgian and international engineering teams

• Work closely with external consultants, contractors and other technical partners

• Review technical design decisions and challenge or adjust them where necessary

• Manage design changes and assess their impact on the overall project

• Translate complex client requirements into technically feasible solutions

• Present and discuss technical concepts with clients and project teams

• Remain involved during the execution phase and act as a technical point of contact for clients and internal stakeholders

For the position of Project Lead Multidisciplinary Engineering – Data Centres, we are looking for someone who combines strong technical knowledge with excellent coordination skills. Experience within data centres is an advantage, but experience with industrial buildings or other technically complex building projects can also be a strong match.

• You hold a Master’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Electromechanical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering or a comparable technical discipline

• You have at least 5 years of experience coordinating multidisciplinary engineering or design projects

• You have experience leading and coordinating engineers and other technical stakeholders

• You are familiar with complex technical building installations and multidisciplinary engineering

• Experience with data centres, industrial buildings or other complex built environments is a strong advantage

• You are familiar with digital engineering processes, 3D design and BIM environments

• You have a good understanding of relevant standards, regulations and working methods within engineering and construction

• You communicate effectively with engineers, consultants, contractors and clients

• English knowledge is a must, Dutch and French are a plus

If you do not have relevant experience in a comparable position or project environment, we kindly ask you not to apply for this vacancy.

LVO Industries is a permanent capital holding company. We acquire family-owned and owner-operated businesses and partner with them to ensure their long-term success. At LVO, you’ll join a small, dynamic team operating in an entrepreneurial environment.
 

Role & Responsibilities :As CTO, you are the digital control tower of the LVO group, responsible for the digital aspects of every portfolio company: Odoo, AI, software development and the Microsoft stack. You bring strong engineering and real AI expertise, set the standards, and make sure the right technology choices and practices are followed everywhere. The job is as much about coaching the teams as building IT solutions yourself in Odoo, AI and beyond. Your responsibilities will evolve over time, and will at least include:
 
 

• make sure all digital tools (Odoo, AI agents, the Microsoft stack, other third-party software) are well chosen and used to their full potential across teams. 

• ensure the IT teams are highly efficient and well-functioning, coaching them on engineering and AI best practices, code quality and testing. 

• drive the development of AI agents to accelerate automation, improve customer satisfaction and replace costly tools, building them yourself and enabling the POs and IT teams to build and run them. 

• implement, follow up and continuously optimize Odoo across the portfolio companies. 

• oversee the broader technical foundation: hosting, architecture, cybersecurity, testing and data. 

• help select external providers and partners, and make sure they deliver.  

Success means a digital strategy that performs across the group: strong automation, a better experience for staff and customers, solid cybersecurity, and technology that is future-proof and cost-effective.

Mindset :More than anything else, we are looking for a candidate with a positive attitude, who is:
 
 

• a builder who codes and configures as naturally as they advise 

• a teacher at heart who leaves teams stronger than they found them 

• obsessed with using AI and automation to remove friction 

• comfortable carrying influence without a title to back it up 

• self-starting, pragmatic, allergic to needless process 

• at ease jumping between companies, stacks and roles 

• dependable: says what they'll do, then does it  

Requirements :
 
 

• a genuine developer and IT engineer background (degree in engineering, computer science or equivalent): you have built and shipped software yourself, stay hands-on with code, and are comfortable across the stack from application architecture to hosting, cybersecurity and automated testing 

• between 5 and 10 years implementing IT and automation projects, including ERP set-ups, in small and medium-sized businesses. 

• real depth in AI: hands-on experience designing and deploying AI-based solutions, and a clear view on applying AI best practices in a business context 

• able to be based in Brussels (Watermael-Boitsfort) and to travel within Belgium. 

• strong written and verbal communication skills in Dutch, French and English

Zymofix is a dynamic and innovative scale-up dedicated to fostering sustainable and circular agriculture. We specialize in creating effective and economically viable microbial products designed to reduce farmers' reliance on agrochemicals while maintaining high productivity. Positioned at the forefront of sustainable agriculture, we are committed to delivering cutting-edge solutions that empower farmers to grow healthy crops and improve yields without resorting to chemical fertilizers. Zymofix is planning the construction of an industrial-scale demonstration plant in 2027.
 

 
 

Job Description & Key Responsibilities:
 

We are looking for a motivated, detail-oriented Production Technician to join our microbial production team. In this role, you will play a key part in producing beneficial microorganisms used in biostimulant, biocontrol, and biofertilizer products that support healthy crop growth. Training will be provided, so prior microbiology experience is not required — though it's a plus. Curiosity and attention to detail matter most.
 

 
 

Your tasks:
 
 

• You independently carry out production tasks according to standard procedures: you prepare supplies, sterilize, inoculate, harvest and handle downstream processing. 

• You work under sterile conditions and strictly follow hygiene and sterility protocols, giving contamination no chance. 

• You safeguard product quality at every stage by performing in-process quality and sterility checks. 

• You help with downstream processing and carry out quantification checks as part of the final quality control. 

• You actively contribute to continuous improvement (TPM) and help find solutions when problems arise. 

You might be our perfect match if you meet the requirements below. But don't worry if you don't tick every box, we dare you to apply anyway. You never know if there’s another role at Zymofix that's a better fit for your skills.
 
 

• You have a technical or scientific background: a secondary school diploma, an associate degree (graduaat) or equivalent practical experience. 

• You enjoy steady, hands-on work and feel right at home in it. 

• You understand the basics of microbiology: you know what bacteria and fungi are and how contamination occurs, and you're interested in sterility and hygiene. 

• Repetitive tasks don't put you off: you stay focused and precise, even over long periods. 

• You can stand for extended periods and regularly lift and carry moderate loads without difficulty. 

• Have you worked with an ELN (Electronic Lab Notebook) before? That's a plus, but we'll train you either way. 

• You're responsible, reliable and a true team player, and safety and hygiene in the workplace come naturally to you. 

• You speak and write both Dutch and English fluently.
